manifest_meta.title: Tolan's small boat fleet welcomes a stronger season

paragraphs.raw_text: DOC_ID: ORV-0037 EVENT_ID: NONE TITLE: Tolan's small boat fleet welcomes a stronger season SOURCE_NAME: Raven Wire SOURCE_TYPE: news RELIABILITY: 2 PUB_DATE: 2026-07-22 PUB_TIME: 11:20 COUNTRY: Tolan SECTOR: general LANGUAGE: en --- Tolan's small boat fleet welcomes a stronger season
[P1] Tolan's fishing cooperatives report a better season for inshore boats, with steady catches and firm prices at the harbour market.
[P2] The fleet has asked the ministry for help with cold storage, saying the current facility is full at the peak of the season.
[P3] "We are landing more than we can keep," said a cooperative secretary. "The market is good; the ice is the problem."
[P4] The ministry says it is reviewing the storage request.

[P5] The cooperative says the season has been helped by calm weather and by a good run of smaller species close to shore. Prices at the harbour market have held up because buyers from the hotels and the processing plant have been active. The cold store is the one part of the chain that has not kept pace, and the fleet wants the ministry to help fund an extension before the next peak. The ministry says the request is being considered alongside other port improvements.

[P6] The cooperative says the cold store was built for a smaller fleet and a shorter season. It has asked for a survey before the ministry considers any funding. The tourism board says the harbour is also busier with visitors, which adds to the pressure on the quay. The ministry says it will reply after the survey.
[P7] Tourism operators say the harbour is busier than last summer.
